written.headline: Nvidia stock drops as board reportedly prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang
written.summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly planning to oust co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang following reports of extramarital affairs. The company's stock fell about 8% in after-hours trading on Wednesday and is down about 11% over the past five days.

written.headline: CoreWeave plans $4B+ investment-grade loan after raising revenue forecast
written.summary: CoreWeave Inc. plans to raise at least $4 billion through an investment-grade loan facility led by Morgan Stanley and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group Inc. Early pricing discussions indicate an anticipated yield between 7% and 7.5%, following the company's upgraded full-year revenue forecast of $13 billion to $13.3 billion.

written.headline: AWS releases AWS Emulator built entirely by AI agents
written.summary: AWS released AWS Emulator, a free tool that simulates over 200 AWS services locally. AWS stated that its engineers did not write or review a single line of code in the tool.

written.headline: UK-backed AI chip startup Fractile hits $7 billion valuation
written.summary: UK-backed AI chip startup Fractile has raised $720 million in a Series C funding round, valuing the four-year-old company at $7 billion. The chip designer has not yet released a commercial product, with its first chip planned for next year.

written.headline: Nvidia board prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang amid scandal
written.summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy and a second relationship with an internal company vice president. Nvidia and Huang are also facing a shareholder class-action lawsuit filed in a U.S. federal court in San Jose, California, while Nvidia's stock fell following the reports.

written.headline: Howard Lutnick stalled curbs on Nvidia chip diversion to China
written.summary: Howard Lutnick stalled curbs on companies suspected of diverting Nvidia chips to China. President Trump authorized the crackdown for the third time this year on November 5.

written.headline: Ethan Mollick discusses AI's transformation of software engineering
written.summary: Ethan Mollick posted on Bluesky that artificial intelligence has substantially transformed the coding profession in less than a year. He stated that claims about companies retreating from AI use do not match reality.
